message.content:
## Recent developments
* **CEO Transition & Resignation:** Jensen Huang resigned as NVIDIA CEO effective November 12, 2026, following revelations of an extramarital affair and an independent board investigation into foreign intelligence targeting reports [1, 2, 3]. Colette Kress (EVP and CFO) was appointed Interim CEO, and Harvey C. Jones was appointed the first-ever Chair of the Board [1].
* **Leadership & Infrastructure Partnerships:** Prior to the transition, NVIDIA, Rebellions, and SK Telecom announced a collaboration on November 8, 2026, to advance Sovereign AI Infrastructure utilizing NVIDIA NVLink Fusion [1].
* **Financial & Corporate Calendar:** NVIDIA scheduled its third-quarter financial results conference call for late October 2026 [1].

## Talking points
* Express continuity support regarding NVIDIA’s interim leadership under Colette Kress and ongoing engineering/infrastructure commitments.
* Discuss the progression of sovereign AI infrastructure initiatives, specifically the recent NVLink Fusion collaboration with SK Telecom and Rebellions [1].
* Review ongoing expectations and execution timelines for upcoming third-quarter financial disclosures.

## Open questions
* How will the interim leadership structure under Colette Kress affect near-term product roadmaps and strategic partnerships?
* What are the findings or expected timelines of the independent investigation initiated by the Board of Directors?
* How does the transition impact upcoming global deployment plans for Sovereign AI infrastructure and regional collaborations?

## Sources
* [1] NVIDIA Newsroom - NVIDIA Announces CEO Transition (https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition)
* [2] NVIDIA Newsroom - Statement From NVIDIA Board of Directors (https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/statement-from-nvidia-board-of-directors)
* [3] CBS News - Timeline of a scandal: How Jensen Huang's abrupt resignation unfolded at Nvidia (https://www.cbsnews.com/news/jensen-huang-nvidia-resignation-scandal-timeline)
